theme: Light & Dark Mode Support (Dark Mode as Default to highlight the glowing bubbles)

typography.rules: Use tracking-tight for headings > 32px. No 'Inter' for headings. Never default to 'Bold', use 'Light' or 'Black' for impact.

colors.palette_strategy: Jewel & Luxury adapted for SaaS (Dark Blue Dominant, Neutral grays).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use high-end glass (backdrop-blur-xl) on header, sidebar, and bubbles. DO NOT use muddy gray transparency. Add a 1px inner stroke (border-white/10) to separate it from background.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Translucent bubble aspect: highly rounded (pill-shaped), gradient purple to dark blue, white text, inner glow.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse ambient shadows, never harsh drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights for tactical minimalism.

layouts.general_strategy: Responsive desktop-first with persistent Sidebar navigation. Use pure HTML + Tailwind CSS for major layout structures.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8, p-12) to prevent text collision.
layouts.admin_dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
layouts.client_dashboard_grid: Top Section: 3 Floating Bubbles (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8). Use 'aspect-square rounded-full' for the bubbles to make them perfect circles.
layouts.sidebar: Fixed, glassy or solid dark blue background. Collapsible on mobile.

motion.client_bubbles: Framer Motion applied to the 3 client widgets (Lucros/Despesas/Saldo). Add continuous floating animation: animate={{ y: [0, -10, 0] }}, transition={{ duration: 4, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }}.
motion.hover_states: Buttons and cards must scale up slightly (scale-105) and increase shadow opacity.
motion.page_transitions: Smooth fade-in and slight upward slide for new pages.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Text inside bubble buttons must be white. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have higher contrast than default state.

media.icons: lucide-react (as requested). Use for sidebar navigation and dashboard metrics.

images.description: Sophisticated bar interior for the Login page background. Apply a dark overlay to ensure the login form pops.

3d_libraries.charts: Recharts (BarChart, AreaChart, PieChart). Customize chart tooltips with glassmorphism and match the app's purple/blue palette.
3d_libraries.motion: Framer Motion for page transitions and the continuous floating animation of the client dashboard bubbles.

instructions_to_main_agent: Interface MUST be in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
Use Javascript (.js), DO NOT use Typescript (.tsx/.ts).
Login flow should distinguish between ADMIN and CLIENT.

For the Client Dashboard, create a dedicated 'DashboardBubble' component using Framer Motion (motion.div) that is 'aspect-square rounded-full flex flex-col justify-center items-center' and features the translucent purple-to-dark-blue gradient.
Admin Dashboard requires Recharts for statistics (AreaChart and PieChart).
Client Dashboard requires an 'Upload de comprovantes' area with OCR (simulate with drag & drop/camera UI).
Client panels have restrictions visually based on 'Básico/Profissional/Premium' plans.
DO NOT use pure complete transparent background on header, overlays, or any surface. ALWAYS use backdrop-blur and a slight opacity color (e.g., bg-black/60).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients (except for the requested purple-to-dark-blue bubbles).
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...).
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...}).
